content.short: Paradigm Faucet airdrops ETH, wETH, DAI and NFTs to developers across testnets Goerli, Optimism Goerli, Polygon Mumbai, Arbitrum Rinkeby and Moonbase Alpha.
content.description: Paradigm Faucet is an infrastructure faucet that airdrops ETH, wETH, DAI and NFTs to developers across multiple testing networks, including Goerli, Optimism Goerli, Polygon Mumbai, Arbitrum Rinkeby, and Moonbase Alpha (Moonbeam). It allows one claim every 24 hours. To collect tokens, users must connect a Twitter account at least one month old to deter botting. The broad network support gives developers flexibility when testing contracts on EVM blockchains like Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum and Moonbeam. This breadth of support helps testers simulate real-world interactions across a wide range of EVM-compatible networks.
